title: Comparing a gradient boosting algorithm to the GOES FDC for wildfire detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.01994v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wildfires pose severe risks to human life, ecosystems, and property. This study presents a machine learning approach for wildfire detection from GOES ABI imagery. A CatBoost model was trained on a large dataset with thousands of ABI images and over 300,000 matching VIIRS fire detections. An evaluation on a separate dataset across five regions showed that the learned CatBoost model outperformed the operational GOES Fire Detection and Characterization (FDC) product. It achieved higher precision, recall, and F1 scores both within and outside the training area. The CatBoost model achieved F1 scores that were 0.16 to 0.38 higher than the GOES FDC in all regions. In addition, out of 51 historical fire events, the CatBoost detected 26 fires before both VIIRS and GOES FDC, compared to only six earlier detections by the GOES FDC. translated_title: 比较梯度提升算法与GOES FDC用于野火检测
translated_abstract: 野火对人类生命、生态系统和财产构成严重威胁。本研究提出了一种基于GOES ABI图像的机器学习野火检测方法。CatBoost模型在一个大型数据集上进行了训练，该数据集包含数千张ABI图像和超过30万个匹配的VIIRS火点检测数据。在覆盖五个区域的独立数据集上的评估表明，训练得到的CatBoost模型优于业务运行的GOES火灾检测与表征（FDC）产品。它在训练区域内外均取得了更高的精确率、召回率和F1分数。在所有区域中，CatBoost模型的F1分数比GOES FDC高出0.16至0.38。此外，在51次历史火灾事件中，CatBoost在VIIRS和GOES FDC之前检测到26起火灾，而GOES FDC仅提前检测到6起。重要的是，CatBoost模型在夜间也能实现准确的野火检测，而GOES FDC（原文截断于此）。
tldr: 基于CatBoost梯度提升算法的机器学习模型在GOES ABI图像野火检测任务中全面超越业务化的GOES FDC产品，F1分数提升0.16至0.38，且能在夜间实现准确检测并更早发现火灾。
en_tdlr: A CatBoost gradient boosting model trained on GOES ABI imagery outperforms the operational GOES FDC wildfire detection product, achieving F1 scores 0.16–0.38 higher across all regions, earlier fire detection, and accurate nighttime performance.
